What is a food and drug license and who needs it? A food and drug license is a legal requirement for any business involved in the manufacturing, distribution, or sale of food and pharmaceutical products. Whether you're operating a restaurant, food processing unit, pharmacy, or drug manufacturing facility, you must obtain this license to ensure public health and safety compliance. How are FDA Licenses in India regulated and issued? FDA Licenses in India are issued and regulated by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) for food businesses and by the Central Drugs Standard Control Organization (CDSCO) for pharmaceutical products. The type of license you need depends on the nature and scale of your operations. What is an FDA manufacturing license and when is it required? An FDA manufacturing license is mandatory for businesses involved in the production of drugs, cosmetics, or certain categories of food products. This license ensures that manufacturing facilities comply with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and meet the standards set by the regulatory authority in India. How do I apply for a food and drug license in India? To apply for a food and drug license, you must submit an application through the appropriate regulatory body—FSSAI for food businesses and CDSCO or your State FDA for drugs and cosmetics. The process typically includes submitting business details, manufacturing plans, and safety compliance documents to obtain the required FDA licenses in India.

sections.heading: Section 7
paragraphs: In India, an "FDA license" typically refers to a license issued by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) or an equivalent State Drug Control Authority, under the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940. This license is mandatory for manufacturing, distributing, or selling drugs, cosmetics, or certain food items in India.
There are many products that need FDA certification. Below is a list of some products that need FDA certification -

FDA Certificate For Food Products: Actually, food products don’t require any kind of FDA License; only food facilities require it. FDA officials visit and conduct thorough inspection of the food plants in India to issue food and drug license. FDA officials examine whether food plants are complying with prescribed standards set by the FDA.

FDA Cosmetic Certificate: Cosmetic products and companies don’t necessarily require FDA license. In certain cases the FDA regulates cosmetic product as a drug product, which may require cosmetic products to get FDA manufacturing license.

FDA Drug Certificate: FDA examines whether any particular drug adheres to the Over-the-counter (OTC) monograph. OTC monograph tells us about conditions in which the drug products are safe and effective for use. If any drug is not complying with the OTC monograph, then it will require FDA manufacturing license.

FDA Certificate For Medical Devices: The FDA classifies medical devices into three classes, namely Class I, Class II, and Class III. Medical devices that are placed in class III, are regarded as highly risky devices. Devices such as pacemakers, breast implants, and replacement heart valves, etc. fall in class III and necessarily requires FDA certification.
There are many benefits of getting an FDA certificate. A few of them are mentioned below -
Increase Demand Of The Product: FDA certification can boost the demand of your products because consumers believe that products with FDA certification are tested and safe to use.
Access To International Markets: FDA approval provides an international standard to your product. FDA approved products can be sold in the markets of different countries of the world.

Enhance Reputation Of The Brand: Food and drug license enhances the credibility of the brand because the FDA has international recognition. Having FDA approval itself tells about the standard of a product, which helps in establishing the product in the international market.

Opens Ways For Funding: FDA manufacturing license certifies that the manufacturer follows high level of standards in production. It will draw the attention of many big companies and investors towards the product for investment.
A list of required documents is as follows:
Commodity-Specific Documents (As Applicable):
Documentation stating the manufacturer of the product
Intended use statement/end use statement of the product
